# Java translated to Rust

Translated 5565 of 52627 methods (2 more are done another way in Horizon) and 4306 of 9207 static fields to Rust (26 of those call the game, through Horizon's helpers); 1 of 2 Fabric event handlers. It's in `runtime.rs`, under `pub mod java`; code that calls the game is in `game_side.rs`.

Each method is translated whole or not at all. A method that can't be (it uses Minecraft, a lambda, null...) is left out with its reason, and so is every method that calls it.

## Why methods were left out

| Cause | Methods | For example |
|---|---|---|
| Calls or uses other code that isn't translated | 35577 | `AccessoryBagApi.getInventoryNamePattern(0)`: it uses AccessoryBagApi.inventoryNamePattern$delegate, which isn't translated (it uses RepoPattern, which isn't translated (it extends `CommonPatternInfo`)) |
| Other Java this translator doesn't handle yet | 5681 | `CollectionApi.onInventoryFullyOpened(1)`: its body couldn't be read: `var` |
| Uses other libraries | 3999 | `AccessoryBagApi.isAccessoryBag(1)`: it calls `Intrinsics` (kotlin.jvm.internal).checkNotNullParameter |
| Uses Minecraft classes (needs Horizon's game API) | 1153 | `EnoughUpdatesManager.stackToJson(1)`: it uses Minecraft's `ItemStack` |
| Uses files (java.nio / java.io) | 317 | `ConfigFileType.file_delegate$lambda$0(1)`: it uses `File` (java.io) |
| Shares one object between names (Java references) | 157 | `GetFromSackApi.addToInventory(2)`: it changes an object through a second name |
| Uses Java collections other than List (Map, Set...) | 78 | `ClientEvents.lambda$5$1(2)`: it uses `CompletionStage` (java.util.concurrent) |
| Uses null | 62 | `HandleEventModuleValidator.validate$lambda$0$0$0(1)`: `null` (Rust has no null: this needs an Option) |
| Uses inheritance (extends, implements, instanceof) | 20 | `BestiaryApi.getInInventory(0)`: `instanceof` |
| Uses Gson (JSON) | 6 | `ComponentArgumentType.adapter_delegate$lambda$0(0)`: it uses `TypeAdapter` (com.google.gson) |
| Uses try/catch | 6 | `StringUtils.getBytesUnchecked(2)`: a try/catch (UnsupportedEncodingException) |
| Done another way in Horizon | 2 | `ConfigModMenuInterop.getModConfigScreenFactory(0)`: done another way in Horizon: the mod's page in Options > Mods (its settings buttons) |
| Uses Fabric API | 2 | `ClientEvents._init_$lambda$4(1)`: it uses Fabric's `LevelRenderContext` |
| Uses JOML maths (vectors, matrices) | 1 | `GuiEditManager.getDummySize(2)`: it uses `Vector2i` (org.joml) |
| Uses lambdas or method references | 1 | `ModifyVisualWords.doReplacements(1)`: its body couldn't be read: a method reference |

## Fabric event handlers

| Handler | Hook | Result |
|---|---|---|
| at/hannibal2/skyhanni/config/commands/CommandsRegistry.java:75 | `command` | not translated: its command tree: a command registration that isn't a lambda |
| at/hannibal2/skyhanni/SkyHanniModLoader.java:32 | `init` | `on_init`, called from the hook, without: the call to `INSTANCE.preInit(..)`: it uses SkyHanniMod.INSTANCE, which isn't translated (it uses SkyHanniMod, which isn't translated (it implements `CompatCoroutineManager` (at.hannibal2.skyhanni.utils.coroutines))); the call to `INSTANCE.init(..)`: it uses SkyHanniMod.INSTANCE, which isn't translated (it uses SkyHanniMod, which isn't translated (it implements `CompatCoroutineManager` (at.hannibal2.skyhanni.utils.coroutines))) |
